brief.statement: One site for an agency that does five things:
brief.muted: client work, a print shop, a school, courses and hiring.

body: StudioTheon calls itself a DesignTech company: brand identity, UI/UX, motion and animation, web and mobile development, print and packaging.
Its portfolio runs from full branding for 360 Furnishings and Dasheen Atelier to visual identities for ChowPae, Farmwell and Ayekoo Honey.
The navigation mirrors the business: Services, Projects, About, Products, Careers and Learn.

Fifteen projects each get their own case page, laid out as overview, problems and solutions, research, design stages and results. The services page lists every design and development service with its starting timeline.

list: A print storefront for business cards, postcards, stickers, packaging and merchandise, with next-day delivery on selected products.
An accelerated programme with four tracks: graphic design and motion, digital marketing, voiceover acting for animation, and programming.
Short courses in 2D and 3D animation, UI/UX, brand identity and design technology.
